subject: Cross type for combined RILs and BC population

messages.author: d87390ba7a81a219
messages.subject: Cross type for combined RILs and BC population
parts:
Hi

I have a RILs population (F7) and also the same population after cross to one of the original parents, that I want to analyze together, what is the appropriate cross-type I should use?

Thanks

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Cross type for combined RILs and BC population
parts:
R/qtl doesn't include a cross type for the cross of RILs to one of the parents, nor a way to combine the two crosses.

But in one sense, I think you could think about such data as multiple phenotypes on the one RIL population. In the RIL x parent backcross population, just the RIL chromosome is varying genetically.

karl
